headlines.title: Apple stock sinks as global memory crisis hurts profits, giving Ternus his first big test
headlines.summary: Apple disappointing on gross margins is a tape-mover of the first order — this thing touches every index, every ETF, and every portfolio manager on the planet. A memory cost squeeze also ripples straight into the semiconductor supply chain, hitting names like Micron and SK Hynix. Coming off a $1 trillion rally with 'no room for error,' a margin miss from the new CEO is exactly the kind of cold water that can reset the whole tech complex.

headlines.title: Meta seeks to raise up to $25 billion in debt sale as AI spending jumps
headlines.summary: Twenty-five billion in new paper from Meta is a monster deal that hits the credit markets at exactly the wrong moment — junk spreads are already blowing out on AI capex fears, and now the investment-grade market has to absorb this slug too. It signals that the hyperscalers are doubling down on AI infrastructure spending even as Wall Street is questioning the return on that capital, which keeps the 'AI bubble' debate front and center. Watch the long bond and credit spreads for the market's verdict.

headlines.title: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
headlines.summary: JOLTS coming in at 7.52 million versus a 7.15 million consensus is the kind of upside surprise that gives the Fed cover to stay hawkish — Treasuries sold off on the print, and that's the tell. With payrolls due later this week, a hot labor market read keeps rate-cut hopes on ice and puts pressure on rate-sensitive sectors like real estate and utilities. I've been burned calling macro before, but a number this far above the bar ahead of payrolls Friday is hard to ignore.
